SELECT a.id, a.title, a.activity_type, a.cover_url, a.project_id, a.inheritor_id, a.start_time, a.end_time, a.address, a.quota, a.signed, a.signup_deadline, a.status, a.create_time, a.update_time, p.project_name AS projectName, h.name AS inheritorName, (a.quota - a.signed) AS remaining FROM ich_activity a LEFT JOIN ich_project p ON p.id = a.project_id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ich_inheritor h ON h.id = a.inheritor_id AND h.deleted = 0
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT a.*, p.project_name AS projectName, h.name AS inheritorName, (a.quota - a.signed) AS remaining FROM ich_activity a LEFT JOIN ich_project p ON p.id = a.project_id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ich_inheritor h ON h.id = a.inheritor_id AND h.deleted = 0 WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.deleted = 0
